description: All-in-one installer for Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable runtimes for Windows ARM64, including legacy x86 and current ARM64 packages.
post_install: if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand -FilePath "$dir\VisualCppRedist_AIO-arm64.exe" -ArgumentList '/ai', '/gm2' -RunAs)) { throw 'VisualCppRedist AIO ARM64 installation failed.' }
notes: This manifest is for Windows ARM64 only. It runs the official 7-Zip SFX package in quiet mode and requests administrator approval to install the included Visual C++ runtimes system-wide.
The upstream installer checks for and removes existing non-compliant Visual C++ runtimes before installing its packages. Review the vendor documentation before installing.

Scoop uninstall does not remove the system runtimes. The upstream Uninstaller.cmd removes all detected Visual C++ runtimes (except UCRT), including runtimes not installed by this manifest; it is intentionally not run automatically.
